title: Update Content Standards Response
description: Response from updating a content standards configuration

success.description: Indicates the update was applied successfully. Deprecated: the envelope `status` is the single authoritative response state (core/protocol-envelope.json), and this flag is removed in 4.0. Senders keep sending it through 3.x, because 3.x receivers may read it.

standards_id.description: ID of the updated standards configuration

success.description: Indicates the update failed. Deprecated: the envelope `status` is the single authoritative response state (core/protocol-envelope.json), and this flag is removed in 4.0. Senders keep sending it through 3.x, because 3.x receivers may read it.

errors.description: Errors that occurred during the update

conflicting_standards_id.description: If scope change conflicts with another configuration, the ID of the conflicting standards
